requirements.statement: The task metadata uses format version one with required fields, permitted values, safe package paths, required entry types, and nonempty command argument arrays.
requirements.classification_rationale: The guide defines concrete metadata fields, types, values, path restrictions, and manifest entry type predicates. These deterministic checks fit pre submission inspection. Extension explanations and grading effects are evaluated separately as qualitative work.

check_specification.stage_rationale: Parsing one metadata file and comparing explicit values and declared paths with the verified manifest is bounded and fits the pre submission limit.

inputs.purpose: Supplies entries referenced by metadata.
Supplies entry types for declared metadata paths.
Supplies the metadata document.

check_steps: Parse task metadata as format version one metadata.
Require format_version to be integer 1.
Require id to start with a lowercase letter, contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and have at most 80 characters.
Require title to be nonempty.
Require environment.dockerfile to name a package relative regular file and environment.context to name a package relative directory.
Require environment.platform to explicitly identify a Linux container platform with a nonempty architecture component. The guide platform examples are illustrations rather than a closed value list.
Require reference.command and verification.command to be nonempty arrays of command arguments rather than shell strings.
Require reference.working_directory and verification.working_directory to name package relative directories.

Treat the dot value as the implicit package root directory only for environment.context, reference.working_directory, and verification.working_directory. Do not require a manifest entry for that implicit root directory.
For every other declared metadata path, require the appropriate contained regular file or directory manifest entry.

Require resources.cpu_millis, resources.memory_bytes, resources.disk_bytes, resources.build_timeout_seconds, resources.reference_timeout_seconds, and resources.verification_timeout_seconds to be positive integers.
Reject absolute paths and upward traversal in every declared path.
Allow only format_version, id, title, environment, reference, verification, resources, and optional extensions as top level fields.
When extensions is present, require it to be a metadata table rather than a scalar or array.
pass_conditions: The metadata parses as format version one.
All required fields have the required types and explicit value constraints.
The dot value is accepted without a manifest entry only in environment.context, reference.working_directory, and verification.working_directory.
Every other declared path stays inside the package and has its required regular file or directory entry type.
Reference and verification declarations are nonempty argument arrays.
No unsupported top level field is present, and optional extensions is absent or a table.

failure_findings.condition: Metadata does not parse as format version one, contains a top level field other than format_version, id, title, environment, reference, verification, resources, or optional extensions, or has extensions as a scalar or array rather than a table.

failure_findings.message: Task metadata has a missing or invalid required value.

failure_findings.condition: A declared path is absolute, contains upward traversal, escapes the package, names an entry with the wrong type, or uses the dot value outside the three permitted package root directory fields.
failure_findings.message: Task metadata contains an unsafe or invalid path.

failure_findings.condition: Reference or verification command is not a nonempty array of command arguments.
failure_findings.message: Reference and verification command declarations must be nonempty argument arrays.

positive_tests: Complete metadata with integer format version 1, a valid id, nonempty title, all three permitted dot directory fields, valid other declared paths, a Linux container platform, positive resources, and nonempty argument arrays passes.

requirements.statement: Verification derives expected results independently from written rules, checks every documented command, accepts every permitted implementation, preserves assertions despite reference disagreement, and avoids undocumented or implementation specific grading.

requirements.statement: Actual isolated build and runtime trials demonstrate offline reproducibility, required isolation, author only material exclusion, reference integrity, independent verifier behavior, substantive starter rejection, incomplete repair rejection, three fresh reference passes, execution of every documented command, and the declared runtime contract.
requirements.classification_rationale: These are actual build, layer, permission, visibility, workspace effect, verifier, interruption, and whole process resource outcomes. They require isolated execution in a nested submitted environment and prepared offline materials, not source review or documentary claims.

check_specification.stage_rationale: Building the declared environment, inspecting layers and runtime conditions, executing repeated fresh trials, and observing complete process trees require background execution.

inputs.purpose: Supplies the complete task package.
Supplies declared environment, workspace, execution, and resource conditions.
Supplies every documented command, behavior, isolation conditions, and failure semantics.
Supplies incomplete repair procedure, trial claims, and coverage mapping.
Supplies starting workspace trials.
Supplies the reference repair.
Supplies verification material and protected expected inputs.
Supplies approved offline images, dependency cache material, layer inspection tooling, and process observation tooling.

check_steps: Build the declared environment using only prepared offline material.
Inspect built layers and solver visible runtime material for reference code, hidden fixtures, expected results, author notes, and the author only incomplete repair method.
Allow solver visible examples only when instructions identify them as examples and they are not any author only material category.
Create independent fresh copies of the starting workspace.
Run solver, reference, and verifier without administrator privileges and observe writable workspace and temporary locations.

Observe absence of network access, host socket access, device access, elevated privileges, author specific home reliance, credential reliance, undeclared cache reliance, and reliance on platform specific filesystem ordering.
Apply the reference from starting state and run protected verification.
Run the same verifier and protected expected inputs against a fresh untouched workspace, a reproducibly applied incomplete repair, and workspaces with missing or fabricated required output.
Confirm the untouched starter fails a substantive documented requirement rather than an infrastructure condition.
Confirm the incomplete repair handles an ordinary case but fails a named requirement, and confirm the author only reproduction method is not exposed to solvers.
Run the reference and full verification in three independently prepared workspaces.

Exercise every documented command, documented operations, main behavior, boundaries, interactions, failure behavior, nonexample inputs, promised records, artifacts, interruption effects, and restart effects.
Confirm verification neither repairs the workspace nor selects results based on actor role.
Observe unattended completion, exit semantics, diagnostics, conditional randomness and time behavior, tolerance consistency, and whole process resource use.
pass_conditions: The environment builds and runs using prepared offline material.
Built layers and solver view exclude reference material, hidden fixtures, expected results, author notes, and the author only incomplete repair method.
Solver visible examples are identified in instructions and are not relabelled author only material.
Solver, reference, and verifier operate unprivileged with writable work locations and without prohibited network, host, device, credential, home, cache, or filesystem order reliance.
The reference performs requested work from starting state without reading protected verification material or installing precomputed answers.
The reference passes full verification in three independent fresh workspaces.
The unchanged starter demonstrates a substantive documented task failure.
A reproducibly applied plausible incomplete repair that handles an ordinary case fails a named requirement, and its reproduction method remains author only.
Verification rejects missing and fabricated required output without altering the workspace to make it correct.
The same verifier and protected expected inputs are used across workspace states, with workspace state as the only differing condition.

Every documented command and documented behavior is exercised and runs complete unattended with correct exit behavior, useful diagnostics, relevant reproducibility treatment, and whole process use within declared allowances.

failure_findings.message: The reference must perform requested work from the starting state.

failure_findings.message: Verification must reject invalid output without repairing the workspace.

failure_findings.condition: Verification behavior or protected expected inputs differ by actor role rather than workspace state.
failure_findings.message: Verification must use the same protected inputs across workspace states.

failure_findings.condition: A documented command, operation, effect, boundary, interaction, failure behavior, nonexample input, interruption effect, or restart effect is not exercised.
failure_findings.message: Verification does not exercise every required documented command and behavior.

failure_findings.condition: A demonstrated run fails unattended completion, exit semantics, diagnostics, a relevant reproducibility condition, or a declared whole process allowance.
failure_findings.message: Execution does not meet the declared runtime contract.

positive_tests: A task with offline isolated execution, protected author only materials, three successful fresh reference trials, meaningful incomplete repair rejection, exercised documented commands, and a verifier that rejects prescribed invalid states passes.

requirements.statement: When feedback leads to a revision, the complete declared verification suite is rerun in the submitted environment and produces observed rerun evidence.
requirements.classification_rationale: Actual revision reruns require execution in the submitted task environment. Conservatively rerunning the complete declared verification suite avoids inferring an affected check set from free form changes and feedback.

check_specification.stage_rationale: A fresh writable workspace, reference application, and complete verification suite execution in the submitted environment require background isolated execution.

inputs.purpose: Supplies the revised package and declared verification suite.
Supplies declared reference and verification execution context.
Supplies the starting workspace used to stage a fresh writable revision trial.
Supplies the reference material applied during the revision trial.
Supplies the complete declared verification suite and protected expected inputs.
Supplies authenticated submission state identifying a first submission or supplying prior state and feedback.
Supplies approved offline material for complete suite reruns.

check_steps: Determine from authenticated submission state whether revision context exists.
When revision context exists, stage a fresh writable workspace from the submitted starting workspace.
Apply reference.command from reference.working_directory in that fresh workspace.
After reference application, run the complete verification.command suite from verification.working_directory in that same fresh workspace.
Record observed outcomes for the complete suite.
Pass without asserting rerun work when authenticated submission state identifies a first submission.
Do not treat the untouched starter as a successful revision proof.
Do not derive an executable affected check set from free form feedback or changes.
pass_conditions: When revision context exists, a fresh writable workspace is staged before reference application.
When revision context exists, reference.command is applied from reference.working_directory before the complete verification.command suite runs from verification.working_directory.
When revision context exists, the complete declared verification suite has observed successful outcomes.
When authenticated submission state identifies a first submission, the conditional requirement passes without asserting a rerun.

failure_findings.condition: Revision context exists and observed execution of reference application followed by the complete verification suite in a fresh writable workspace is absent.
failure_findings.message: A revision must have observed complete suite rerun evidence.

failure_findings.condition: Observed execution shows that reference application or the complete verification suite fails for the revised package.
failure_findings.message: The revised package fails the complete verification rerun.

positive_tests: A revision with observed successful reference application and complete verification rerun in a fresh writable workspace passes.
A first submission identified by authenticated submission state passes this conditional requirement.

negative_tests.name: revision_without_complete_rerun
negative_tests.scenario: Feedback leads to a revision but no observed complete verification suite rerun is available.

negative_tests.name: revision_suite_failure
negative_tests.scenario: Reference application completes in a fresh workspace but the observed complete verification suite fails.

runtime_dependencies.purpose: Runs reference application and the complete verification suite in the submitted task environment.
Provides authenticated prior state and feedback or identifies a first submission.
Provides approved offline materials for complete suite reruns.

infrastructure_failures.condition: The isolated runner or nested task environment is unavailable.
Authenticated submission state, prior revision material, feedback, or prepared offline material is unavailable.

requirements.statement: A claimed measured task difficulty is supported by supplied solver evaluation evidence, while a package making no such claim is accepted without a fresh solver evaluation.
requirements.classification_rationale: Identifying a measured difficulty claim and assessing supplied evaluation records, provenance, and consistency are qualitative evidence reviews. The guide requires evidence supporting a claim, not a newly run solver evaluation by Workstream.

check_specification.stage_rationale: A short background rubric reviews conditional difficulty claims and supplied supporting records without creating a fresh solver trial obligation.

inputs.purpose: Supplies difficulty claims and references to supporting evaluation evidence.
Supplies included supporting evaluation records and provenance disclosures.

check_steps: Identify statements that present task difficulty as measured.
Pass when no measured difficulty claim is present.
When a claim is present, review supplied solver evaluation records, stated provenance, and consistency with the claim.
Do not infer ownership or authenticity beyond supplied evidence and do not require a new solver trial.
pass_conditions: No measured difficulty claim is made, or each measured difficulty claim is supported by supplied solver evaluation evidence with stated provenance and consistent results.

failure_findings.condition: A measured difficulty claim lacks supplied solver evaluation evidence or stated provenance.
failure_findings.message: Measured task difficulty claims require supplied solver evaluation evidence.

failure_findings.condition: Supplied solver evaluation evidence materially conflicts with the measured difficulty claim.
failure_findings.message: Difficulty claims must be consistent with supplied evaluation evidence.

positive_tests: Notes with no measured difficulty claim pass.
A measured difficulty claim with supplied consistent solver evaluation evidence passes.

negative_tests.name: difficulty_estimate_as_measurement
negative_tests.scenario: Notes state that task difficulty was measured but provide only an estimate or expectation.

runtime_dependencies.purpose: Applies the conditional difficulty evidence rubric.

infrastructure_failures.condition: The model evaluation service is unavailable.

requirements.statement: A contributor raises an environment requirement that cannot meet guide constraints for project clarification before completing the task.
requirements.classification_rationale: Raising and resolving an environment clarification is Workstream project operation rather than evaluation of a submitted package.

requirements.statement: Revision eligibility and timing are controlled by displayed assignment policy rather than this guide.
requirements.classification_rationale: Revision eligibility and timing are Workstream owned project operation outside package evaluation.

capability_suggestions.title: Package layout manifest checker
capability_suggestions.rationale: Implement deterministic normalized archive root path and entry type checks.

capability_suggestions.title: Task metadata contract checker
capability_suggestions.rationale: Implement documented metadata grammar, value, path, entry type, dot root, extension table, and argument array predicates.

capability_suggestions.title: Solver brief and extension disclosure rubric
capability_suggestions.rationale: Provide a background qualitative comparison of instructions, visible examples, metadata extensions, author notes, and verification materials.

capability_suggestions.title: Materials reproducibility and notes rubric
capability_suggestions.rationale: Provide evidence bounded review of documentary presence, material custody, directory explanations, pinning, provenance, licensing, offline preparation, and reproducibility disclosures.

evidence_refs.section: package materials reproducibility and author notes

capability_suggestions.title: Verification independence rubric
capability_suggestions.rationale: Provide a background rubric comparing written rules, expected result derivation, reference material, and verification constraints.

capability_suggestions.title: Offline task execution trial runner
capability_suggestions.rationale: Provide nested isolated execution, prepared offline materials, built layer inspection, protected workspace trials, and whole process observation.

capability_suggestions.title: Author evidence accuracy comparison rubric
capability_suggestions.rationale: Provide authenticated isolated trial records and a background rubric comparing them with author evidence claims.

capability_suggestions.title: Revision objective comparison rubric
capability_suggestions.rationale: Provide prior task and feedback material plus a background rubric for conditional change explanation and objective preservation.

capability_suggestions.title: Revision complete suite runner
capability_suggestions.rationale: Provide revision context, prepared offline material, nested execution, fresh workspace reference application, and complete suite observation.

capability_suggestions.title: Difficulty claim evidence rubric
capability_suggestions.rationale: Provide a background assessment of conditional measured difficulty claims and supplied solver evaluation records without requiring a new solver trial.
